card.name: Opioid in REMS requirement sentence
card.fires_on: The word "opioid" in the stock REMS sentence "drug companies with approved opioid analgesic products must make REMS". It also fires weakly on "an" after "rifampin," before "inducer".

modes.label: REMS opioid sentence
modes.description: The word opioid right after "drug companies with approved" in the opioid analgesic REMS paragraph.
modes.example: Under the requirements of the REMS, drug companies with approved<< opioid>> analgesic products must make REMS

modes.label: Appositive before inducer
modes.description: The word "an" after a drug name and comma, introducing a description of an enzyme inducer.
modes.example: Concomitant administration of atorvastatin with rifampin,<< an>> inducer of cytochrome P4

card.plain: It lights up on the word opioid in the standard sentence about companies with approved opioid analgesics making REMS materials available.
